channel.title: OmniSource Updates
channel.description: OmniSource is a curated, automatically maintained AltStore-compatible iOS app source. Every entry is resolved from the app's own official upstream project - GitHub Releases or the developer's official AltStore feed - and each download link is re-verified automatically.

item.title: UTM v5.0.7
item.description:
UTM 5.0.7 | Universal IPA
## Highlights * (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited. * **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only). * **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27. * (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes. * (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode. * (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.
## Notes * Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM. * The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15. * We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU. * (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first. * (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX. * Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
## Changes (v5.0.7) * Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration * QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820) * QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display * Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916) * Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon) * (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad * (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped * (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK" * (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944) * (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12 * (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183) * (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson) * (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller * (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed * (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914) * (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)
## Changes (v5.0.6) * Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758) * Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends * Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26 * Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery * Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484) * Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604) * SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751) * SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159) * CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814) * Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened * Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon) * (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27 * (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774) * (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad * (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738) * (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard * (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped * (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver * (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik) * (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F) * (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183) * (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen * (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field * (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar * (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875) * (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec) * (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777) * (macOS 27) AVF: Run without saving changes (#4201, #7326) * (macOS 27) AVF: Secure Boot option for UEFI guests (#7874) * (macOS) Scripting: Snapshots are now scriptable objects, and utmctl gains `snapshot` and `discard-state` commands * (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth) * (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757) * (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam) * (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)
## Changes (v5.0.5) * ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~ * Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon) * Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8. * Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files * Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. item.title: Streamyfin v0.55.2
item.description:
Streamyfin 0.55.2 | streamyfin-ios
## What's Changed
0.55.2 is another bug fix release. One thing does change: a TV is now signed in from your phone with Quick Connect, so Quick Connect has to be on in your server's dashboard (it is by default) and both devices need this version. The rest again comes out of the crash and error reports, plus a round of fixes to accounts and the Seerr sign-in
Thanks to everyone who reported a problem, and to @Gauvino for the Quick Connect and Seerr fixes!
### ✨ Highlights - **Signing a TV in from your phone uses Quick Connect**, with a code or a QR code, and no longer sends your password over the local network (#2240) by @Gauvino - **Freezes of a few seconds when playback starts or resumes** on iOS and tvOS are fixed (#2205) by @fredrikburmester - **Access tokens are kept out of the app log**, including the logs you export, and entries written by earlier versions are cleaned up (#2103) by @Gauvino - **Seerr access no longer carries over** to the next account signed in on the same device (#2233) by @Gauvino - **Quick Connect in Settings** sends the code on its sixth digit and tells you why a code fails (#2246) by @Gauvino - **Luxembourgish** is available as an app language (#2195) by @Gauvino
### 🎬 Player - iOS and tvOS: the app no longer freezes for several seconds when playback starts or resumes while the system audio service is slow to answer (#2205) by @fredrikburmester - Music: tapping a track far down the queue before the rest has loaded no longer fails, and neither do previous and next with repeat all (#2212) by @fredrikburmester
### 📺 TV - Pairing a TV with a phone goes through Quick Connect: the TV shows a code and a QR code, your phone approves it, and the TV signs in by itself. No password travels between the two devices, and the TV picks its own server (#2240) by @Gauvino - On the phone, Settings > Log in on TV scans the QR code or takes the code typed in, and the entry now shows on iPhones too (#2240) by @Gauvino - The TV offers a new code when the old one runs out after ten minutes, and says so when Quick Connect is turned off on the server (#2240) by @Gauvino - "Save this account" works with a Quick Connect sign-in: the TV asks how to protect the account before showing the code (#2240) by @Gauvino - The TV signs in as the phone's user, and a TV still on an older version has to be updated before it can be paired (#2240) by @Gauvino - Switching account on a TV no longer leaves the previous account's Seerr session and plugin settings in place for the next one (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino
### 🔑 Sign-in & Accounts - Settings > Quick Connect sends the code on its sixth digit or when you paste one, and shows why a code failed under the cells instead of in a dialog, with the code kept for a fix (#2246) by @Gauvino - Approving a Quick Connect code while Quick Connect is turned off on the server no longer signs you out. The app tells you it is off instead (#2246, #2247) by @Gauvino - iOS: the toolbar with a "Default" button above the number pad is gone from the Quick Connect code and the account PIN fields, and a tap beside the field closes the keyboard (#2236, #2242) by @Gauvino - Settings from the Streamyfin plugin are applied right after signing in, Quick Connect included, instead of at the next refresh (#2197) by @Gauvino - The Seerr sign-in that follows a login runs right away, and only once (#2197, #2231) by @Gauvino - One account's Seerr session, and the Seerr and OpenSubtitles keys the plugin gave it, no longer reach the next account signed in on the device (#2197, #2233) by @Gauvino
### ⬇️ Downloads - An item with nothing to download, like a folder, a photo or a book, shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2210) by @fredrikburmester - Downloading the last missing episode of a season uses that episode's own version, audio and subtitle tracks, not the first episode's (#2214) by @fredrikburmester
### 🐛 Fixes - Access tokens are redacted from the app log and from exported logs, and entries written before this update are redacted too. On iOS the name of an external subtitle track carried the token into the log (#2103) by @Gauvino - Opening a library sends one request with that library's own sort and filters, instead of a first one carrying the previous library's (#2256) by @fredrikburmester - The Live TV guide and the item counts on library cards load when they open before the session has been restored, instead of staying empty (#2209) by @fredrikburmester - Streamystats: an answer without results no longer breaks the home recommendation rows and search (#2203) by @fredrikburmester - A custom link the in-app browser cannot open is handed to the system, and one that nothing can open shows a message instead of doing nothing (#2211) by @fredrikburmester - Fixed an error after restarting the app when something had been changed while offline, like marking an item as played (#2208) by @fredrikburmester - iOS: custom header values can be read when the system starts the app in the background on a locked phone, once this version has been opened one time (#2215) by @fredrikburmester and @Gauvino
### 🔧 Build & Infra - Crash reporting sends less: more network and proxy failures the app can do nothing about are skipped (#2204) by @fredrikburmester - Routine dependency updates (#1874) by @renovate[bot] and @Gauvino
### 🌍 Translations - Luxembourgish (Lëtzebuergesch) is available in the language picker (#2195) by @Gauvino - Ongoing Crowdin sync (#2095, #2213, #2241) by our translators on Crowdin - Want to help translate Streamyfin? Join us at [translate.streamyfin.app](https://translate.streamyfin.app)
### 🛟 Support & Reporting Bugs
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [open an issue](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues/new/choose). Search [existing issues](https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/issues) first and add to a match if there is one. - **Questions and help:** [Discord](https://discord.streamyfin.app)
**Include in bug reports:** app version, platform and device, OS version, Jellyfin server version, direct play or transcoding, the media's codecs and subtitle format, which player you used (native or standard), steps to reproduce, and logs or a screen recording if possible.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamyfin/streamyfin/compare/v0.55.1...v0.55.2

item.title: EscapeOS v0.1.8
item.description:
EscapeOS 0.1.8 | EscapeOS-0.1.8
## EscapeOS 0.1.8
v0.1.0, v0.1.1, v0.1.3, v0.1.4, v0.1.5, and v0.1.6 are unchanged. 0.1.7 was never published; its two fixes are in this release.
### Fixed - **Import from Files works again for new files and Keep Both.** Since 0.1.6 both failed with "That folder is outside this app's data." An app's container is reported under `/private/var`, and the folder check only stripped that prefix for paths that already exist ([#4](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/4)). - **`InvalidHostID` now explains itself.** It means the device does not recognise EscapeOS's pairing file. The message used to blame LocalDevVPN and Wi-Fi ([#5](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/5)). - **Sharing a file can no longer delete EscapeOS's own data.** Share wrote into EscapeOS's Documents and replaced whatever had that name, so sharing a file called `Backups` or `pairingFile.plist` removed every backup or the pairing file. Shares now use a private temporary folder.
### Added ([#3](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/pwnapplehat/EscapeOS/issues/4)) - **Search Whole App** finds a file or folder by name anywhere in an app's data. - **Favorites** at the top of the Apps tab; they still open after an app is reinstalled. - **Replace / Keep Both / Cancel when pasting** a name that already exists. A folder is never replaced, a file is never replaced by itself, and Replace swaps the file in atomically so a failure leaves the original. - **Free-space check** before Compress, Share Zip, Duplicate, Paste, Import and Backup, with a clear message instead of a late failure. - **Share / Save to Files** on each backup.
### Changed - **Deleting a file now asks first**, naming what will be deleted. Files can opt out with "Delete, Don't Ask Again" (Settings turns it back on); folders and backup archives always ask.
Theos arm64 IPA (iPhoneOS 16.5 SDK, `MinimumOSVersion` 18.0), same build path as 0.1.6. After install, reconnect LocalDevVPN if the list is empty; iPASide places `pairingFile.plist` again after sideload.
**Verification:** built for iOS; 200 automated checks of the path, paste, delete, search, favorites and free-space logic run against the real source; the changes were reviewed independently and its findings fixed. **This build was not run on a device**, so the screens (search, favorites, the paste and delete prompts) have not been seen on a phone.
`EscapeOS-0.1.8.ipa` SHA-256:
``` d374147e22605b09bc85b84551704ed0725bb3ac2179c8edc0af9f9ec2ce6269 ```

item.title: Battman v1.1.0
item.description:
Battman 1.1.0 | TrollStore
## Battman 1.1.0
In this version, I have finally put something in the 'Analytics' page, added native plug-in support, and fixed a bunch of bugs.
**PLEASE LET ME KNOW** when you want any new features or find any bugs. You can create a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/new) to describe them, especially when something behaves differently on your device.
- Implemented the 'Analytics' page with cards that you can add, remove, resize and rearrange ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)). - Added ten Analytics cards: live readings, capacity observations, cell voltages, charging sessions, battery discharge, connection and charging states, power readings, time by battery level, charging comparison, and discharge rhythm. Graphs include capacity history and comparisons of complete 20% to 80% charging sessions; available readings depend on your device and its recorded history. - Added native plug-in support, including `.battman` import, plug-in management, diagnostics and recovery mode. Third-party plug-ins require your approval, and changes take effect after restarting Battman ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)). - Added the public Plugin SDK and plug-in example sources for developers ([#53](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/53)). Charge Gauge is provided as a **source example**, not as a shipped production plug-in. - Added a 'Temperature Unit' option: System, Celsius, or Fahrenheit ([#43](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/43)). - Added `zh_TW` localization and documentation ([#35](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/35)). - Added 'Export Powerlog' to the charging graph. Long-press the graph to export the available system battery log. - Improved charging-limit settings, daemon connections and charging controls; unavailable or invalid battery readings now have clearer explanations ([#54](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/54)). - Fixed potential deadlocks in battery-status callbacks and improved battery refreshes while scrolling ([#39](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/39), [#40](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/40)). - Improved crash logging for the app, daemon and worker processes ([#38](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/38)). - Fixed DOD0 units and misleading battery-authenticity warnings, and corrected invalid time-to-empty estimates ([#45](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/45), [#46](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/46)). - Fixed crashes when reading accessory and UPS battery information, including disconnects during a refresh ([#47](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/47)). - Removed unused system-group entitlements to address the remaining iOS 17 backup issue after the earlier fix attempt ([#32](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/issues/32), [#41](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/pull/41)). - Improved Analytics history browsing, graph readability and scrolling responsiveness. - Bundled the gettext runtime so localization can work without a system gettext installation. - Improved **Wipe all Battman data** to wait for Analytics cache writes and report deletion failures, and replaced legacy icon-font dependencies with vector fallbacks.
### Dependencies (deb)
- `libintl8` or `libintl`
### Support List
The table below retains the installation-method overview from previous releases. It is **not a complete tested-device list for 1.1.0**; you still need a jailbreak or TrollStore version compatible with your particular device and iOS build.
| iOS \ Chip | <= A10 / A10X | A11 | A12 Series | A13 | A14 / M1 Series | A15 / M2 Series | >= A16 / M3 Series | |:----------:|:-------------:|:---:|:----------:|:---:|:---------------:|:---------------:|:------------------:| | < 12.0 | Unsupported | Unsupported | - | - | - | - | - | | 12.0 | Unsupported | Jailbreak | Jailbreak | - | - | - | - | | 13.0 | Unsupported | Jailbreak | Jailbreak | Jailbreak | - | - | - | | 14.0 | Unsupported | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | - | - | | 15.0 | Unsupported | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | - | | 16.0 | Unsupported | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Jailbreak / TrollStore | Untested | | >= 17.0 | Unsupported | Untested | Untested | Untested | Untested | Untested | Untested |
* Unsupported: Outside Battman's current iOS 12.0 / A11-or-newer baseline. * Untested: No independently completed device-testing coverage is claimed for this combination. * Jailbreak: An installation method on compatible jailbroken systems; **Roothide jailbreak was not considered in this list**. * TrollStore: An installation method using [TrollStore](https://github.com/opa334/TrollStore), where that device and iOS build support it. * Analytics: Individual readings depend on the hardware and available system logs. Missing readings remain unavailable, and incomplete history is not treated as a complete measurement.
### Choose your package
`com.torrekie.battman_1.1.0_iphoneos-arm.deb`: For your rooted jailbreaks, typically on iOS 12.0 ~ 14.x.
`com.torrekie.battman_1.1.0_iphoneos-arm64.deb`: For your rootless jailbreaks, typically on iOS 15.0 or above.
`Battman.tipa`: The Battman host app for TrollStore. Please notice that **DO NOT install deb and tipa versions at the same time**. You can only keep one installation on your device.
`BattmanPluginSDK-1.1.0.tar.gz`: Plugin SDK source for developers, under the MIT License.
`BattmanPluginExamples-1.1.0.tar.gz`: Buildable source examples, including the SDK Analytics card and Charge Gauge. Charge Gauge retains the repository's Non-Commercial Attribution License; the SDK subtree remains MIT-licensed. These are source archives, with no compiled plug-in packages or external plug-ins included in the release TIPA.
Native plug-ins run inside Battman with its permissions. A valid signature identifies the publisher and package, but does not make the code safe. On TrollStore installations, activating an additional native plug-in requires a replacement TIPA containing it; importing a `.battman` package alone is not enough.
Only the `.deb` or `.tipa` package is needed to install Battman. The SDK and example source archives are for developers; the `SHA256SUMS*` files are for verification and do not need to be installed.
`SHA256SUMS.p256.sig` signs the exact `SHA256SUMS` inventory. The SHA-256 fingerprint of the P-256 checksum key's uncompressed public point is:
`5709282ae05ae482b09bde0f463ad6659ef33bc2237736917cddebd0c9069d75`
**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.3.3...v1.1.0](https://github.com/Torrekie/Battman/compare/v1.0.3.3...v1.1.0)

item.title: Conduit v4.2.0
item.description:
Conduit 4.2.0 | conduit
## What's Changed * Add Open WebUI client parity and Advanced UI controls by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/807 * Make everyday Open WebUI features available without Advanced and polish the new screens by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/808 * CI: run steps in parallel, cache Gradle, and trim setup by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/810 * Add Flutter control facades and a narrow platform UI vocabulary (1/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/811 * Enforce the platform UI seam with a shrinking allow-list (2/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/812 * Route settings selection controls through platform UI (3/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/813 * Use platform UI chips for reactions, decisions and folder icons (4/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/814 * Use platform UI controls for launcher loading and Direct retries (5/5) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/815 * Keep the chosen reasoning effort when the model selector is reopened by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/821 * Store Open WebUI servers and accounts in one registry (1/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/817 * Keep several Open WebUI accounts signed in and switch between them (2/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/818 * Switch, add and sign out of Open WebUI accounts from the profile (3/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/819 * Reach an Open WebUI server through whichever of its addresses answers (4/4) by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/820 * Save several named Hermes connections and switch between them by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/816 * Stop downloading whole chats again when they open by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/826 * Keep the docked iPad sidebar visible to VoiceOver by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/827 * Put every account and connection on one Accounts page, and add them from one sheet by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/828 * Support Open WebUI 0.12 by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/843 * Talk with a realtime voice in calls on Open WebUI, Hermes and Direct by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/842
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.9...v4.2.0

item.title: Reynard v0.17.1
item.description:
Reynard 0.17.1 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.17.0...0.17.1
This is a minor release that fixes issues found in 0.17.0. For the complete list of changes, see the [0.17.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.17.0).
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Text selections outside input fields now offer more actions, such as Look Up, Find Selection, Translate, and Share. - Fixed a crash when editing in scrollable text fields on iOS 14 and older. - Fixed an issue where touching the selection handles to drag them would clear the selection in text fields on some webpages. - Fixed an issue where the caret and text selection would not stay aligned with sticky text while scrolling. - Fixed an issue where tapping a focused text field or caret would not bring up the edit menu on iOS 17 and later. - Fixed an issue where images copied from another app would not paste into webpages.
